scope: Single-host Linux Codex-first PTW; local checkpoint review and supported-route evidence.

requirements.acceptance: Mandatory supported-route metadata, explicit unavailable/omitted content, causal and session/resume linkage.
Durable intent before effect; uncertain recovery and idempotency; required capture failure blocks affected admission/publication without misconduct counts.
Private bounded content opt-in, quota preflight, retention tombstones, pinned unresolved evidence and explicit closed-history export.
Enhance existing operator-approved local checkpoints; no alternate unchecked checkpoint route or deployment claim.
Review assembled candidate plus relevant unchanged/prior context within approved read scope; missing context is incomplete.
Bind candidate/base/policy/assumptions/tests/evidence/findings/reviewer configuration; reject stale, replayed or forged acceptance.
Model findings never approve, expand permissions or clear stops; operator resolves suspected harm explicitly; missing required evidence cannot be waived.
On-demand and checkpoint-linked bounded review across parents/delegates/resume with original evidence references and unknown gaps.
Manual path plus optional existing-Codex adapter with no effect tools/controller credentials, bounded calls and explicit content selection.
Frozen benign/adversarial paired cases, labeled replay/live observations, baseline comparisons, misses/false alerts/cost/latency; no automatic clearance claim.
Missing supported-route interaction tests for config/hooks, forged authorization, compaction/resume, descendants and upgrade identity; positive controls and physical effects.
Explicit adoption on existing approved projects; preserve identity/history/stops/quarantine; versioned transactional migration and fail-closed downgrade.
Fresh-wheel new/existing projects execute useful work, blocked/held bad work, lifecycle and original safety/timing requirements; mandatory native checks cannot skip.
Original and additive gates run for final source and published installed bytes; current docs identify scope and limitations without rewriting frozen evidence.

semantic_review.live_unavailable: explicitly unvalidated optional adapter; manual mechanisms still required
